chunks: And inspect the affairs of the land tax (kharāj) in a manner that brings prosperity to its people, for indeed in their prosperity and the prosperity of the tax-payers lies the prosperity of those other than them, and there is no prosperity for those other than them except through them, because all people are dependent upon the land tax and its people.

key_terms.أَهْلَهُ: Its people (those engaged in or paying the tax)

ai.seo_question: How does the prosperity of tax-payers affect the general population according to Imam Ali's instructions to Malik al-Ashtar?
ai.summary: In this foundational directive from Nahj al-Balagha, Imam Ali (AS) establishes the principle of 'prosperity of the people leads to prosperity of the treasury,' emphasizing that the tax base (ahl al-kharaj) is the economic engine for the entire state. This instruction reflects the Shia political ideal of just governance (adl), where the ruler’s duty is to cultivate the wealth of the subjects rather than merely extract it, ensuring social stability and economic sustainability.
